native_components.ships_in_release_build: Android release: YES, and has since 0.7.4+985. CORRECTED 2026-08-15 by compliance - THE PREVIOUS 'all four ABIs' FIGURE WAS AN OVER-CLAIM, and it was wrong in two independent ways. It read: 'libmpv.so ships for all four ABIs (arm64-v8a 12,369,680 B; armeabi-v7a 11,746,532 B; x86 13,172,484 B; x86_64 15,816,336 B)'. Those four are the UPSTREAM JARS (default-arm64-v8a/armeabi-v7a/x86/x86_64.jar), which are build INPUTS enumerated before the ABI filter runs; they are not shipped output. WHAT ACTUALLY SHIPS, measured by opening the APKs themselves rather than reading a build directory: the newest ARCHIVED BUILD, 0.8.1+1002, contains exactly TWO ABIs (called 'the current release' here until 2026-08-19, which contradicted this same file and SOURCE_OFFER.md: no 0.8.1 build has been publicly distributed, so the last DISTRIBUTED release is 0.8.0+993 and +1002 is a measured candidate, not a release) - lib/arm64-v8a/libmpv.so 12,369,680 B sha256 adf83fde58a9f6751ce6e83b9b187f651425d53ec0e20da04deb8dfb4aa775e1 and lib/armeabi-v7a/libmpv.so 11,746,532 B sha256 8aa2b23d16d941a8d685b8eb995b1cb31677ed3e28c55c776954eb1618ab1a2e - because intergalactic/android/app/build.gradle's release block sets ndk.abiFilters 'arm64-v8a', 'armeabi-v7a'. (1) x86 HAS NEVER SHIPPED IN ANY RELEASE APK: 45 archived release APKs spanning 0.6.5 through 0.8.1+1002 were enumerated and ZERO contain a lib/x86/ path, with lib/x86_64/ present in 43 of them as the positive control that the search works. So the notice named an architecture no project has ever received. (2) x86_64 is not merely 'still shipping' either - it shipped from 0.6.5 through 0.8.1+996 (lib/x86_64/libmpv.so 15,816,336 B sha256 f030e9a1a4d4664e89d7160a3d4528cd5875ee023ff6262e16e95aac28ffaec5) and the LAST RELEASE MEASURED CARRYING IT IS 0.8.1+996. The first measured WITHOUT it is 0.8.1+1001; the builds between +996 and +1001 are not in the archived set and were therefore not measured either way, so +996 is the last release this evidence can assert the obligation for and +1001 is the first it can assert it against. An earlier version of this field said 'shipped through +996' and 'stopped at +1001' in one breath, which reads as two different last-carrying releases and leaves the obligation for the gap undefined. The source obligation for x86_64 persists for every release up to 0.8.1+996 even though that ABI is absent from the current build. The four-ABI figure hid both facts by being wrong in the direction that looked complete. libmediakitandroidhelper.so (MIT) ships for the same two ABIs: 386,696 B arm64-v8a, 286,812 B armeabi-v7a.

artefact_digests.note: SHA-256 recorded by compliance 2026-08-15 because the Android build verifies its downloads with MD5 only, where the Apple build uses SHA-256.
